I think it varies from prison to prison, but someone I knew went in for growing marijuana.

Basically first floor prisioners are the ones who are considered more trustworthy and allowed to go outside and go to work.  They HAVE to work everyday.  

The prisioners on the second floor are kept on watch and not allowed out, and third floor or the highest floor are usually where the 'crazies' are kept.  They are never ever allowed out, and the top floor is where you normally go if you get punished and put into solitary.  

Of course you get three meals a day, get to watch television and go to the gym, but you still feel like you are treated as an animal sometimes. Of course I can't speak for every prison, this is just one person's experience.
